_comment: Claude Desktop config for the GeoLens read-only MCP server. Merge the mcpServers block into your existing claude_desktop_config.json (macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/, Windows: %APPDATA%\Claude\) and restart Claude Desktop. As written it points at the public demo instance and needs no credentials. For your own instance, change GEOLENS_INSTANCE and add "GEOLENS_API_KEY": "your-api-key" to the env block. If Claude Desktop reports 'spawn uvx ENOENT', replace "uvx" with its absolute path from `which uvx`.
